StatusLIVE EXECUTIVE DASHBOARD
PurposeFounder-level command board for proving whether the UNYRA operating system is adopted, used correctly, refreshed on cadence, and resilient under live commercial, operational, compliance, and trust-linked pressure.
Source ruleUpdate the founder dashboard, control routing matrix, control integrity review, executable-check board, owner accountability review, task queue, release reviews, adoption SOP, and linked functional records first, then refresh this board.
Founder useDecide whether the system is becoming operating behavior, or whether premium documents are still depending on founder force to become real.
Protection ruleThis dashboard measures adoption and readiness only; approved templates, brand assets, and source-record protections stay unchanged.

Adoption Behavior Control PostureLink

Control lensCurrent postureFounder readRequired response
Structural adoptionCore dashboard, CRM, operations, compliance, SOP, and archive surfaces are broadly live.The system is now rich enough that folder existence is no longer the success metric.Measure behavior proof, cadence freshness, and owner-led use quality.
Live-gate adoptionExecutable-check discipline exists, but same-day trust-linked usage is still maturing.The strongest controls matter most when urgency tries to bypass them.Treat each trust-linked payment, release, or override as an adoption stress test.
Founder dependenceSeveral layers still become clean faster when founder pressure is visible.Founder rescue is evidence that adoption is incomplete, not proof that the system works.Route repeated founder-rescued behavior to owner accountability and variance recovery.
Closure disciplineOpening controls is stronger than closing learning loops.Premium structure can still leak value if shipment, claim, CAPA, and profitability closeouts lag.Require closeout evidence before a workflow is counted as adoption-stable.
Scale readinessThe system can support more volume, but only if usage quality becomes less founder-forced.Scale should not arrive before behavior has caught up with design.Graduate layers through readiness tiers before widening operating reliance.

Readiness Maturity LadderLink

Maturity stageDefinitionEvidence requiredFounder posture
InstalledThe folder, dashboard, template, or record exists and follows naming rules.Correct route, protected template source, current preview, and owner visibility.Useful but not adoption proof.
UsedThe layer is referenced during actual decisions or reviews.Recent source update, linked decision, and current owner action.Count as live but still watch cadence.
Owner-ledThe owner refreshes the layer before founder chase or same-day pressure.Dated owner update, evidence route, and no founder rescue required.Count as meaningful adoption.
Gate-readyThe layer performs under payment, release, claim, pricing, or trust-linked pressure.Current proof, stop rule, closure path, and relevant escalation record.Count as high-rigor operating behavior.
Scale-readyThe layer stays current across cycles and reduces founder intervention.Repeated cadence proof, KPI or recovery movement, and clean closeout evidence.Permit broader reliance and volume.

Adoption Escalation and Stop RulesLink

RuleConditionRequired escalationFounder action
Founder-rescue repeatSame layer needs founder force twice in one cycle to stay current or correct.Route to owner accountability and plan variance.Treat as adoption failure, not normal founder involvement.
Live-gate bypassTrust-linked release, payment, or override moves without current executable-check evidence.Route to executable-check control and funding-release review.Stop widening until owner-led proof exists.
Closeout gapShipment, claim, CAPA, or profitability record remains stale after operating pressure passes.Route to control integrity and owner accountability.Withhold scale-ready status from the layer.
Chat-first shortcutA material decision happens in chat or memory before the relevant control route is selected.Route to control routing and exception governance.Require retrospective control record and owner correction.
Template-protection breachLive work appears in protected template space or bypasses naming discipline.Route to adoption SOP and founder governance.Stop the workflow until source and working-copy discipline are restored.
